eq-ch08-theta-def: The positivity factor $\Theta_i$ limits a cell's total outflow to its content over the step.
eq-ch08-theta-bound: With the donor factor on every draining face, $V_i(u_i+\Delta t\,\Delta u_i) \ge \eta\,u_iV_i + \Delta t\,\mathrm{in}_i$, non-negative for a cell non-negative at stage entry.
eq-ch08-carry-dm: The mass withheld at a face by the limiter is $(1 - \Theta_d)F$.
eq-ch08-borrow-fractions: A cloud's deficit is shared among its parent vapours by the fractions $f_n=\nu_{nk}\mu_n/\sum_m\nu_{mk}\mu_m$, which sum to one, so the cell total is unchanged.
eq-ch08-fixvapor-sums: A window's deficit $D$ and the vapour $Q$ of its donor cells, both weighted by cell volume; the window ends where $Q - D \ge 0$.
eq-ch08-fixvapor-borrow: Negative cells of the window go to zero and each donor gives up the fraction $D/Q$ of its vapour, so the window's mass is kept and the donors move by the deficit only.
eq-ch08-satadj-state: The saturation adjustment hands kintera the total density, the internal energy density and the mass fractions of each interior cell, formed from the total state.
eq-ch08-sed-stokes: A condensate settles at the slip-corrected Stokes velocity $w_{\mathrm s,n}=2\beta_na_n^2g_1(\rho_{\mathrm p,n}-\rho)/(9\mu)$, unless a prescribed velocity replaces it; either is clamped at the upper limit.
eq-ch08-sed-viscosity: The gas viscosity is the Chapman-Enskog value for a Lennard-Jones gas with a fitted collision integral, and the mean free path follows from it.
eq-ch08-sed-fluxes: The donor cell carries the condensate's mass flux, the momentum it moves and its internal plus kinetic energy, with no pressure-work share.
eq-ch08-carry-prescribed: On a prescribed face the advected and settling parts of the carry have opposite donors, so their withheld energies sum to $s\lvert F_{\mathrm{sed}}\rvert(\hat h_u-\hat h_\ell)$, not zero.
